item.title: Photos: Thousands march across Europe to demand end to Israel’s war on Gaza
item.description: Demonstrations in London, Berlin, and Rome denounce ongoing Israeli attacks on Gaza 'ceasefire' anniversary.

item.title: Attack on airport in Saudi capital, Riyadh, leaves several injured
item.description: Operations suspended at King Khalid International Airport after another attack this week, Civil Aviation Authority says.

item.title: Nine killed in shooting in US state of Pennsylvania, including two children
item.description: The shooting in Erie, Pennsylvania happened on Friday, according to state officials. The attacker is among the dead.

item.title: Pope says death penalty ‘inadmissible’ as US plans to livestream execution
item.description: Pope Leo XIV describes capital punishment as an 'attack on the inviolability and dignity of the person' in post on X.

item.title: Video shows rare albino Asian black bear
item.description: A rare albino Asian black bear was captured on camera in China’s Shennongjia National Park

item.title: Christa Pike discharged from hospital and returned to Tennessee prison
item.description: Pike survived two doses of lethal-injection drugs on September 30, renewing scrutiny of capital punishment.

item.title: Celebrations in Ethiopian city after reported Eritrean ‘incursion’
item.description: People in northern Ethiopia are celebrating after a reported withdrawal of Eritrean forces accused of an incursion.

item.title: Eritrea urges UN to intervene in standoff with Ethiopia
item.description: The neighbouring countries blame one another for starting war amid heightened tensions and fears of a wider conflict.

item.title: Hurricane Isaias leaves two dead and 800,000 without power in US Southeast
item.description: Storm damage stretches across Florida and Alabama as officials warn of continued flooding and possible tornadoes.

item.title: Trump Accounts: Free money, but who gets a say?
item.description: Trump Accounts promise children a financial head start. Al Jazeera’s Emma Withrow spoke with one parent.

item.title: With or without Hamas
item.description: Hamas’s fate will not profoundly shape Gaza’s future.

item.title: Three injured in third school attack in Poland in less than a week
item.description: The attack comes after police announced the detention of 76 people across Poland in connection with previous incidents.

item.title: Liverpool vs Man City: Premier League – teams, prediction, Haaland, charges
item.description: Man City travel to Liverpool for their first game since being found guilty of serious EPL financial breaches.

item.title: Arsenal beat Leeds 2-1 in comeback win to move level with Man City at top
item.description: Arsenal come from behind to beat Leeds United moving them joint top of the Premier League with Manchester City.

item.title: Jerusalem Daily: Israeli settlers attack olive farmers
item.description: Israeli settlers steal olives and attack Palestinian farmers during this year’s harvest.

item.title: Mexican judge sentences three men for murders of Australian, US surfers
item.description: The trial in Baja California had revealed chilling details of the triple homicide of the surfers.

item.title: Why is the US sanctioning the International Criminal Court?
item.description: The sanctions targeting the ICC, which prosecutes humanitarian crimes, are the latest move by the US against the court.

item.title: Abbas postpones Palestinian legislative elections to September 2027
item.description: November 2026 vote delayed; joint presidential and legislative elections set for next year, president says in decree.

item.title: Has Yemen returned to ‘full-scale war’?
item.description: Fighting is intensifying between Yemeni government forces and Houthi rebel group.

item.title: When streets become a workplace: Gaza workers convert tents into offices
item.description: A real estate crisis in Gaza has forced professionals to use tents as surgeries and offices.

item.title: High silver prices threaten Lucknow’s famed bridal nagra craft
item.description: War-driven prices for silver are threatening nagra makers in northern India.

item.title: New Delhi police crack down on protesters ahead of anti-gov’t march
item.description: India’s police have detained dozens of protesters, including ‘Cockroach’ party leaders ahead of an anti-gov't march.

item.title: ‘Anachronism’: Rubio’s civilisational rhetoric prompts pushback from Iran
item.description: Rubio says threats to Western civilisation today 'every bit as real as they were on the dramatic stage of antiquity'.

item.title: Verstappen wins chaotic Singapore GP F1 sprint after Russell crashes
item.description: Max Verstappen's sprint race win was ​Dutchman's first of any kind in Singapore as he finished ahead of Lewis Hamilton.

item.title: India’s ‘Cockroach’ leaders detained; New Delhi in lockdown
item.description: Indian police crackdown appears to have prevented mass protests against the country's election chief from taking place.
